objective: Persist materially useful unresolved maintenance residue and surface or complete it on later Ron-OS-routed work without forcing Ron OS onto unrelated self-contained requests.

roles_before.artifact: Existing narrowed Ron OS orchestration for state-dependent/continuation work
Unresolved audit findings are currently carried only by their affected owners/automation output and may be missed later
PROTOCOL.md live-source mutation gate and Architecture Mode

role_dispositions.destination: Existing exact Ron OS owners and live owners remain authoritative.
Unrelated self-contained requests continue to bypass Ron OS; opportunistic maintenance runs only when Ron OS is already routed.
A minimal canonical unresolved-maintenance queue/checkpoint in Ron OS stores only actionable OPEN residue; completed fixes remain in Git history.
External live writes and architecture/control-plane changes retain existing permission requirements.
Candidate isolation and Git history preserve rollback and provenance.

capability_probes.assertion: State-dependent requests still recover current owners/live owners and are not overridden by maintenance residue.
A self-contained unrelated request does not trigger Ron OS solely because maintenance residue exists.
An unresolved material technical tail is recoverable on a later Ron-OS-routed request without Ron repeating it.
Closed fixes remain recoverable from Git history and are not duplicated indefinitely in runtime state.

tests.command: Run focused fresh-chat probes for unresolved residue pickup, safe deterministic repo-fix completion, and exact-delta proposal when permission is absent.
tests.expected: Material OPEN residue is surfaced/completed only on Ron-OS-routed work and verified before being marked closed.

tests.command: python tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py
